name: Kotor
tagline: A walled town at the end of a fjord-like bay
summary: Kotor is a medieval walled town tucked at the end of the Bay of Kotor, below steep mountains. Climb the fortress walls for a famous view, wander marble lanes full of cats and churches, and boat to island churches and baroque Perast.
seasonNote: Cruise ships crowd the old town in summer; check cruise days. Spring and autumn are calmer.
arrival: Tivat Airport is 20 minutes away; Dubrovnik Airport about 1.5 hours with a border crossing.
gettingAround: Walk the old town; buses and boats around the bay; rent a car for the mountains.
cashTip: Montenegro uses the euro. Cards work in hotels and bigger restaurants; carry cash for boats, taxis and small cafés.
foodTip: Black risotto, mussels from the bay and Njeguši ham and cheese.
buyTip: Local olive oil, Vranac wine and Njeguši prosciutto.

connections.note: Border crossing; can be slow in summer.
